purpose: Teach: 亀裂/覚せい/熱烈/サリン/加速度/臨界/培養/入管

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内に亀裂を生まぬよう対話を重ねろ
lines.en: I want to see continuous dialogue across this company to prevent fractures forming internally.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Words land with deliberate weight. Even pace, no rush. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の覚せい剤検査を契約で明示しました
lines.en: Understood. We've made the drug screening policy explicit in the employment contracts.
lines.style: Respectful, professional acknowledgment. Crisp on the opening affirmative. Steady delivery of implemented details. Slight upward inflection at the end—reporting completion.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お得意様への熱烈な接客を継続しろ
lines.en: Maintain that energetic, attentive service for our key clients.
lines.style: Directive but not harsh. Light emphasis on the action word. Short, efficient phrasing. The confidence of someone delegating something already understood.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サリン級の有害物質には触れさせません
lines.en: Confirmed. We're ensuring staff have no exposure to hazardous substances at that level.
lines.style: Clear confirmation. Methodical listing of the safety measure. Neutral, professional tone—just the facts. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新商品で市場の動きを加速度的に作れ
lines.en: I want our new product line to actively shape market momentum.
lines.style: Commanding but strategic. Slight emphasis on the verb of creation. Steady tempo. The tone of strategic ambition stated plainly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。生産能力の臨界点を見極めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll identify the critical capacity threshold and operate within it.
lines.style: Assured professional affirmative. Calm, deliberate pacing on the operational detail. The tone of someone with a plan.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、培養技術を強化し再生医療に参入しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our cultivation technology and move into regenerative medicine.
lines.style: Expansive ambition delivered with precision. Slight emphasis on the directional verbs. Steady, forward-looking pace. The confidence of a longer-term strategic vision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。入管とのやり取りを丁寧に進めます
lines.en: Understood. We'll manage the regulatory coordination carefully.
lines.style: Final affirmation, slightly weighted with awareness of complexity. Measured pace. The slight deliberateness of someone naming a difficult but navigable path ahead.
